title: 晒经石留痕
subtitle: 不完美的最后一难
origin: 《西游记》第九十九回（低龄温和改编）

moral.zh: 成果遇到意外时，先保护、修复和记录；留下痕迹并不等于失去价值。
moral.en: When work meets an accident, protect, repair, and record it; a mark does not erase its value.

pages.zh: 上岸后，大家发现几层防潮布湿了。沙僧马上找到一块平整的大石头。
pages.en: After reaching shore, they found several damp outer cloths. Sha quickly found a broad, flat stone.
pages.prompt: The established team inspects damp outer wrapping beside a broad flat sunlit stone on the riverbank; scripture scrolls remain protected inside, practical calm mood.

pages.zh: 悟空用树枝搭起小架，八戒摊开布角，唐僧和白龙马按顺序看守经卷。
pages.en: Wukong built small drying racks, Bajie spread the cloth, and Tang Seng and White Dragon Horse guarded the scroll order.
pages.prompt: The established team sets up low safe twig drying racks: Wukong ties supports, Bajie spreads cloth, Tang Seng sorts scrolls by colored ribbons, White Dragon Horse watches; no fire.

pages.zh: 河风忽然变大，一页经纸贴在石面上。悟空伸手去揭，纸角却留下了一小块。
pages.en: A river breeze pressed one scripture page to the stone. When Wukong lifted it, a tiny corner remained behind.
pages.prompt: A cream scripture page with only abstract unreadable ink lines lies against the flat stone; Wukong carefully lifts it while one tiny corner remains, focused close-up, no tearing drama.

pages.zh: 唐僧没有责怪悟空。他们先用干布压平经纸，再把缺角的位置仔细记下来。
pages.en: Tang Seng did not blame Wukong. They pressed the page flat with dry cloth and carefully recorded the missing corner.
pages.prompt: Tang Seng and Wukong gently press the page beneath a clean cloth with smooth wooden weights; Sha records the location using blank diagram shapes, supportive teamwork.

pages.zh: 八戒担心经书不再完整。沙僧说：“完整不是从没受过风雨，而是每次都认真保护。”
pages.en: Bajie worried the scriptures were no longer complete. Sha said, "Wholeness is not never meeting storms; it is caring for what remains every time."
pages.prompt: Sha Wujing reassures Bajie beside neatly drying scrolls and cloths; the team sits together on the warm riverbank, reflective and comforting.

pages.zh: 他们逐卷复查，确认文字都能读清，只少了空白边角，便用新的护纸包好。
pages.en: They rechecked every scroll. All teachings remained clear; only a blank edge was missing, so they added new protective paper.
pages.prompt: The full team carefully checks scrolls with tiny abstract ink lines, then adds cream protective edge paper and ties soft colored ribbons; precise restoration, no legible text.

pages.zh: 夕阳照在大石上，那片纸角像一枚小小的旅程印记，提醒后来人珍惜经卷。
pages.en: Sunset lit the stone, where the tiny paper corner became a travel mark reminding later visitors to care for the scrolls.
pages.prompt: Golden sunset on the broad flat drying stone, with one tiny cream paper corner visible like a gentle historical trace; the established travelers pack nearby, no shrine or readable inscription.

pages.zh: 经包装好后，师徒向东出发。前方云层散开，长安的城郭仿佛已在晨光里等待。
pages.en: With the scriptures packed, the travelers headed east. Clouds opened ahead, and Chang'an seemed to wait in the morning light.
pages.prompt: Wide dawn departure eastward: the established team carries securely wrapped scripture cases, leaving the drying stone beside a calm river; distant Chang'an walls glow beyond clouds.
